risks.proof: Close-up video of every key being pressed

risks.risk: Missing power adapter, stand, or manual
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories together

risks.risk: Hidden damage on back, underside, or internal components

risks.risk: Buttons or keys do not all function

Close-up video of all keys being pressed
Photo of all accessories including power adapter, stand, and manual
